verses.text: Deliver me, Yahweh, from the evil man. Preserve me from the violent man:
lines: Deliver me, Yahweh, from the evil man.
Preserve me from the violent man:

verses.text: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.
lines: those who devise mischief in their hearts.
They continually gather themselves together for war.

verses.text: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips.
lines: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent.
Viper’s poison is under their lips.

verses.text: Yahweh, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.
lines: Yahweh, keep me from the hands of the wicked.
Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.

verses.text: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me.
lines: The proud have hidden a snare for me,
they have spread the cords of a net by the path.
They have set traps for me.

verses.text: I said to Yahweh, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, Yahweh.
lines: I said to Yahweh, “You are my God.”
Listen to the cry of my petitions, Yahweh.

verses.text: Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
lines: Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation,
you have covered my head in the day of battle.

verses.text: Yahweh, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud.
lines: Yahweh, don’t grant the desires of the wicked.
Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud.

verses.text: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
lines: As for the head of those who surround me,
let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

verses.text: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.
lines: Let burning coals fall on them.
Let them be thrown into the fire,
into miry pits, from where they never rise.

verses.text: An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
lines: An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth.
Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

verses.text: I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
lines: I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted,
and justice for the needy.

verses.text: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
lines: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name.
The upright will dwell in your presence.
